title: meta
description: What the public library website and Danbyte's catalog sort, filter and show for one entry: its category, family, a one-line summary, lifecycle dates and links to vendor documents. Allowed on every entry: device overlays, module overlays, pluggables, rack types and rack kits. Only write what a source says; leave a key out rather than guess a date or a URL. Danbyte fills a device type's lifecycle fields from `lifecycle` and creates link Documents from `links`.

category.description: The entry's category, from a closed list so the website's filters stay small. Device types use one of the hardware categories; module types use `module` (plus `module_kind`); pluggables use `pluggable`; rack types `rack`; rack kits `rack-kit`.

module_kind.description: Module types only: what kind of module it is.

roles.description: Free, short, lower-case words for what the hardware is used for. Suggested: access, distribution, core, campus, datacenter, edge, branch, industrial, poe, mgig, stackable, modular, spine, leaf, oob.

family.description: The vendor's product family, as the vendor names it.

summary.description: One plain sentence describing the hardware, no marketing.
examples: 48-port PoE+ access switch with a modular uplink slot

links.description: Vendor documents about the hardware. Danbyte creates one link Document per entry on the device type (its category from `kind`).

sources.description: Anything else used for this entry: dimensions, ports, bays, LEDs, colours.

url.description: An http(s) URL, as found, without tracking parameters.

date.description: A date as YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM when only the month is published.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle dates from the vendor's own notices. `source` is required as soon as any date is given. The catalog derives a state from them: `current`, `end-of-sale` or `end-of-support`.

end_of_sale.description: Last day it can be ordered.

end_of_security_updates.description: Last day of security fixes (vulnerability support).

end_of_support.description: Last day of support (last date of support / end of life).

source.description: The EoL / EoS notice or page the dates come from.

title.description: The document's title as the vendor gives it.

examples.title: Cisco Catalyst 9300 Series Switches Data Sheet
